visualCharacteristics.purpose: Site keyword search field with a submit button that sends the query to the site search results page

contentPattern.structure: one row; first cell holds the input placeholder text (e.g. I am looking for...); second cell holds a link whose text is the button label and whose href is the search results page (query sent as ?question=). Either cell may be omitted (defaults: Search, /search). A bulleted list of links instead renders a jump-to dropdown. If the placeholder cell holds several paragraphs, the first becomes a visible field label and the rest the placeholder (e.g. Still need help? / Type your question here)

reuseGuidance: Use for a standalone search bar in page content, not the header search. Options: rounded (pill field), boxed / boxed-light (full-width bar in a panel). For an index-driven live results listing use the library search block.
